text.zh-CN:
烧伤是热、化学品或电等造成的组织损伤，热水和蒸汽造成的叫烫伤。

- 浅表伤多红痛，深伤可能发白、焦黑或感觉较少。
- 疼痛不重不代表伤得轻，面积、深度和部位都重要。
text.en:
Burns damage tissue through heat, chemicals or electricity; hot liquids and steam cause scalds.

- Superficial injury is often red and painful; deeper injury may be white, charred or less sensitive.
- Less pain does not prove a minor injury; size, depth and site matter.

text.zh-CN:
伤害程度取决于能量、接触时间和身体部位。

- 火焰、热液、热表面是常见原因。
- 电流可能损伤皮肤下面的组织，化学品可持续腐蚀。
- 幼儿皮肤更薄，行动不便者可能难以及时脱离热源。
text.en:
Severity depends on energy, contact time and location.

- Flames, hot liquids and surfaces are common causes.
- Electricity may damage deeper tissues; chemicals can continue injuring skin.
- Children have thinner skin, and limited mobility can delay escape.

text.zh-CN:
严重烧伤应在急救同时送医。

- 大面积、深伤，或面部、会阴等部位受伤需急诊。
- 电烧伤、化学烧伤，或吸入烟雾后声嘶气促，需要紧急评估。
- 意识异常、呼吸困难或明显虚弱时呼叫急救。
text.en:
Severe burns need emergency care alongside first aid.

- Large or deep burns and injuries to the face or genital area require assessment.
- Electrical or chemical burns and smoke-related hoarseness or breathlessness need urgent evaluation.
- Call emergency services for altered consciousness, breathing difficulty or severe weakness.

text.zh-CN:
不能判断深度或处理方式时应咨询医疗人员。

- 幼儿烧伤、手足和关节附近受伤更应早评估。
- 小浅伤可规范护理，红肿疼痛加重、流脓或发热需复诊。
- 愈合不如预期或影响活动，不能一直自行换药。
text.en:
Seek advice when depth or treatment is uncertain.

- Young children and burns near hands, feet or joints need early review.
- Small superficial burns may be managed with care; worsening pain, swelling, pus or fever needs reassessment.
- Poor healing or limited movement should not be managed indefinitely at home.

text.zh-CN:
医生评估的不只是皮肤外观。

- 检查面积、深度、位置及血流和感觉。
- 电伤或吸入伤可能需要心电、呼吸等专项检查。
- 早期深度可能尚不明显，复查可以发现伤口变化。
text.en:
Assessment goes beyond surface appearance.

- Clinicians assess area, depth, location, circulation and sensation.
- Electrical or inhalation injury may need heart or breathing tests.
- Depth may be unclear early, making reassessment useful.

text.zh-CN:
先确认损伤机制，避免错误处理。

- 接触性皮炎、晒伤或摩擦损伤外观可相似，处理不完全相同。
- 化学品接触需去除污染并按专业指导处理。
- 吸入伤可能没有明显皮肤烧伤，不能只凭表面轻微排除危险。
text.en:
Identify the mechanism before choosing care.

- Dermatitis, sunburn and friction injury may look similar but differ in management.
- Chemical exposures require decontamination and professional advice.
- Serious inhalation injury can occur without extensive skin burns.

text.zh-CN:
治疗目标是停止损伤、保护创面和恢复功能。

- 立即冷却热烧伤，之后选择合适敷料。
- 深伤可能需要清创、植皮，严重者需静脉补液。
- 愈合后必要时进行疤痕和关节活动康复。
text.en:
Treatment stops injury, protects wounds and restores function.

- Cool thermal burns promptly, then use suitable dressings.
- Deep injuries may need debridement or grafting; severe burns may require intravenous fluids.
- Scar and movement rehabilitation may follow healing.

text.zh-CN:
药物辅助舒适和处理感染。

- 对乙酰氨基酚等可止痛，避免复方药重复成分。
- 抗生素不是所有小烧伤都需使用，按感染及伤情判断。
- 外用药和破伤风预防由医护选择，不将牙膏、油脂或偏方当药物。
text.en:
Medicines support comfort and selected infection care.

- Paracetamol may help pain; avoid duplicate ingredients.
- Not every minor burn requires antibiotics; use depends on injury and infection.
- Clinicians choose topical agents and tetanus prevention; toothpaste, oils and folk remedies are not substitutes.

text.zh-CN:
营养需求取决于烧伤大小。

- 小伤维持普通均衡饮食即可。
- 大面积烧伤会增加能量和蛋白质需要，应由团队制定营养方案。
- 严重烧伤的补液不能靠在家大量灌水替代；没有食物能迅速去疤。
text.en:
Nutritional needs depend on burn severity.

- Minor burns need ordinary balanced meals.
- Major burns increase energy and protein needs and require planned nutrition.
- Drinking large amounts at home cannot replace major-burn fluid treatment; no food instantly removes scars.

text.zh-CN:
热烧伤后先冷却再覆盖。

- 用凉的流动水冲20分钟，尽早进行；不要用冰直接冻伤口。
- 取下附近饰物和未粘住的衣物，不强撕粘连衣物。
- 冷却后松散覆盖，勿挑破水疱；同时保持未受伤部位温暖。
text.en:
Cool thermal burns before covering.

- Use cool running water for twenty minutes promptly; never apply ice directly.
- Remove nearby jewellery and loose clothing, not material stuck to skin.
- Cover loosely after cooling, leave blisters intact and keep uninjured areas warm.

text.zh-CN:
幼儿、老人和部分慢病患者需更谨慎。

- 幼儿冷却时注意全身保暖，避免长时间全身浸冷水。
- 糖尿病或感觉减退者可能低估损伤深度。
- 行动不便者需要照护者帮助换药、观察感染和维持活动。
text.en:
Children, older adults and some chronic conditions need caution.

- Keep children otherwise warm during cooling; avoid prolonged whole-body cold immersion.
- Diabetes or reduced sensation can hide severity.
- Limited mobility may require assistance with dressing, infection checks and movement.

text.zh-CN:
愈合速度随深度不同。

- 小浅伤常约两周愈合，深伤明显更久。
- 复查关注感染、皮肤覆盖和关节活动。
- 伤口愈合后防晒及疤痕处理听从指导，持续瘙痒疼痛可求助。
text.en:
Healing varies with depth.

- Small superficial burns often heal in around two weeks; deeper burns take longer.
- Review infection, skin closure and movement.
- After healing follow sun and scar-care advice and seek help for persistent itch or pain.

text.zh-CN:
并发症与伤情相关。

- 破损皮肤可感染。
- 大面积烧伤可能失水、休克，吸入伤会影响呼吸。
- 深伤可留疤并使关节活动受限，需要康复。
text.en:
Complications depend on severity.

- Broken skin can become infected.
- Major burns may cause fluid loss or shock; inhalation injury impairs breathing.
- Deep scars can restrict joints and require rehabilitation.

text.zh-CN:
预防从家居与工作环境着手。

- 热饮放在儿童够不到处，洗澡先检查水温。
- 烟雾报警器、用电安全和化学品防护可降低严重事故。
- 不要用热水袋或取暖设备长时间贴住感觉减退的皮肤。
text.en:
Prevention starts with home and workplace safety.

- Keep hot drinks away from children and check bathwater temperature.
- Use smoke alarms, electrical safety and chemical protection.
- Avoid prolonged heaters or hot-water bottles against skin with reduced sensation.
